# Muslim Professionals Network

> A global professional network helping Muslims connect, find mentors, discover Muslim-owned businesses, and grow their careers while staying true to their faith.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the network and how to join.
- [About](/about): Mission, story, and community values.
- [Search Professionals](/search): Directory of Muslim professionals (filters are public; results require login).
- [Businesses](/businesses): Directory of Muslim-owned businesses.
- [Mentorship](/mentorship): Find and request Muslim mentors.
- [Organizations](/organizations): Muslim professional organizations.
- [Scholarships](/scholarships): Scholarship opportunities.
- [Careers](/careers): Career resources and opportunities.
- [News](/news): Community news and updates.
- [Donations](/donations): Support our mission.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the team.
- [Help](/help): Help center and FAQs.

## Optional

- [Login](/login): Sign in.
- [Signup](/signup): Create an account.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.
